purpose: Reconstruct the pre-storage-refactor numerical kernel used by the refined/continued slit and bulk campaigns. Apply the patch in a separate copy of this source revision.
scope: Only force-vector storage differs; equations, stencil, cutoff, forcing and boundary operators are unchanged. Historical pilot/baseline executable hashes are retained separately; binary hashes depend on compiler/build environment.
patch_context: Zero context preserves the historical mixed CRLF/LF source bytes without storing carriage-return context as trailing whitespace.
